Cavalcade Education is run by equine veterinarians to improve equine health through education for professionals, horse owners, and students.

We help veterinarians stay at the top of their game with cutting-edge training that blends research with real-world skills. For horse owners, we offer classes that make it easier to care for their horses and keep them healthy.

For future equine vets, we provide hands-on learning, networking, and courses to build confidence and expertise.

With over 10 years of experience, Cavalcade Education is here to support the equine community every step of the way.
